description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing external asset owner loan product attributes within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, and updating loan product attributes, utilizing JAX-RS annotations and Swagger documentation.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing external asset owner loan product attributes, including create, retrieve, and update operations.

methods.name: postExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttribute
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new external asset owner loan product attribute for a specified loan product.

methods.name: getExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributes
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all loan product attributes for a specified loan product, with optional filtering by attribute key.

methods.name: updateLoanProductAttribute
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing loan product attribute identified by attribute ID.
